::: {.callout-warning}
## Outline
This page is an outline: a summary and the sections planned for it, not yet the documentation. The feature it describes is planned and not yet built. See [Getting Started](index.qmd) for a worked example.
:::

## Overview

How to measure a monitor before anything acts on it, by replaying it over transcripts with Inspect Scout. Covers running a monitor as a Scout scanner, labelling steps to build a validation set, precision and recall, turning a benign score distribution into a threshold, and versioning monitors so a calibration records what it measured.

## Planned Sections

- The development loop: record, replay, label, validate, calibrate
- Recording a benign distribution with `observe()` (available now)
- A monitor as a Scout scanner, `as_scanner()` (planned)
- Validation sets: labelling steps in Scout View; step ids
- Precision, recall and F1 over the validation set
- `calibrate()`: thresholds from a benign distribution, per dimension (planned)
- Versioning a monitor with `@monitor(version=...)`
- Transcripts from other sources: proxies, coding agents
